acceptance_criteria.description: Doctor treats the exact already-approved supported registry version 1.2.0 plus attributable staged provider path as version-aligned while retaining manifest and provider hash validation.
Unknown, missing, foreign, or modified dependency versions and paths still fail closed with version or integration drift.
Focused doctor and provider migration tests, build, and disposable real-Tinto doctor proof pass.

closed_decisions: The existing-provider migration contract already approves exactly registry version 1.2.0 as compatible; doctor must apply that same compatibility predicate instead of requiring equality with the bundled provider's internal version 1.
The integration manifest remains bound to the bundled Pumarejo provider version and all staged provider hashes; this change only aligns inspection of the preexisting Cargo declaration.
WebView runtime heuristic availability is environmental and is not to be bypassed or weakened.

focused: pnpm vitest run tests/integration/doctor.test.ts tests/integration/init.test.ts tests/integration/remove.test.ts tests/unit/attributed-drift.test.ts
natural: Root runs doctor --json against the initialized disposable Tinto reconstruction and confirms integration.version-alignment is ready.

forbidden_changes: Do not edit Cargo planning/removal, provider source/staging, public dialog/process custody, dependencies/lockfiles, git, Jira, queue/blocker/release files, or Tinto worktrees.
Do not broaden supported versions or dependency forms, weaken manifest/provider hashes, or suppress WebView/toolchain diagnostics.
objective: Align doctor version diagnostics with the already-approved exact existing-provider compatibility predicate exposed by the real Tinto proof.
